name: Divination Adept

source.note: Compared with the published D&D Beyond chapter on 2026-10-06: https://www.dndbeyond.com/sources/dnd/au/chapter-1-character-options.

summary: always prepare these spells when you have slots of levels 1, 2, 3, 4, and 5 respectively: Detect Evil and Good; Mind Spike; Clairvoyance; Divination; Scrying. Reference-only: Reaction when a visible creature within 60 feet makes a D20 Test: grant Advantage or Disadvantage. Once per Long Rest; a slotted Divination restores use.
